I work on greenhouse-gas reporting and verification as a regulator. This site is where I ask a related question about AI agents: when an agent acts on someone else’s behalf, what makes that delegation checkable—from setting the terms, to catching errors mid-job, to verifying what happened afterward?

Each note is dated and versioned. The [Tests](cases/index.qmd) page summarizes the small experiments behind the notes. To get new notes by email, subscribe to [Ember Notes](https://buttondown.com/Willember).
